scope: The one-storey carpentry workshop immediately west of the blacksmith forge, with a broad work entrance and plain gable.

originalReview.notes: The exact 1876 McLaughlin image from Qualla shows the late trading post’s low gabled timber ensemble. Roy identifies the carpenter’s workshop as building 8 in the 1888 plan. The current rectangle and the Qualla view give approximate scale and overall timber appearance. The workshop doorway, light windows and small chimney are interpreted.
